test_start_run_endpoint: test the POST /v1/runs endpoint to start an agent run and verify it returns 202
test_run_events_sse_stream: test the GET /v1/runs/{run_id}/events endpoint to stream SSE events for a running agent
test_stop_running_agent: test the POST /v1/runs/{run_id}/stop endpoint to interrupt a running agent and cancel its task
test_run_auth_validation: test that the runs endpoints require Bearer token authentication and return 401 when missing
test_run_error_handling: test the runs endpoints return 400 for invalid JSON, missing input, or empty input
